items.title: Visa overstayers to have work rights revoked if asylum claim rejected
items.description: The federal government is expected to take a hard line on temporary visas as it continues to consider ways to reduce Australia's migration figures.

items.title: ACCC launches inquiry into food labelling claims after Four Corners investigation
items.description: Australia's consumer watchdog has launched an inquiry into allegations of misleading consumer conduct after a major Four Corners investigation examining food fraud.

items.title: Unknown Australian soldiers identified decades after deaths in action
items.description: The soldiers died on the same day, 24 years apart. The first fell in Europe towards the end of World War I and the second in the Pacific Theatre during World War II.

items.title: Travis Head pips star duo to win second-straight Allan Border Medal
items.description: Swashbuckling batter Travis Head's big year — including three Ashes centuries — wins him a second straight Allan Border Medal, with fellow Ashes heroes Alex Carey and Mitchell Starc hot on his heels.

items.title: 'Doesn't look great': Fears Penrith captain could miss rest of NRL season
items.description: Penrith captain Isaah Yeo may miss the rest of the NRL season after injuring his pectoral muscle, while the Sydney Roosters joined the Panthers on top of the table after defeating the Canterbury Bulldogs.

items.title: Ruthless Lions send ominous warning to AFL rivals by dismantling Hawks
items.description: Brisbane shows the rest of the competition why it has won the last two premierships by dominating Hawthorn at the Gabba.

items.title: Fourteen-year-old killed grandparents before deadly school rampage, Thai police say
items.description: At least seven people, including teachers and students, have died after a student opened fire at a school in Thailand.

items.title: Lawyers for Andrew and Tristan Tate urge US judge to release them from jail
items.description: The brothers' lawyers argued their "extraordinary public visibility" would make it impractical for them to try to flee and there was no need to keep them behind bars until proceedings end.

items.title: Racism, hate after Voice referendum caused 'untold harm', inquiry hears
items.description: Aboriginal community-controlled organisations have told the federal racism inquiry that racial bias on the part of child protection workers and police is harming First Nations women and children.

items.title: China accused as Pacific nations block statement condemning missile test
items.description: Naoero and Kiribati stir frustration at the opening day of the Pacific Islands Forum by blocking a regional statement criticising China's ballistic missile test.

items.title: Victoria announces poultry lockdown as bird flu cases spread
items.description: Testing confirmed a further 20 cases of H5N1avian influenza in Victoria on Friday, all in greater crested terns along the state's south-west coast.

items.title: A 'gasp' and he was gone. Coroner warns of Federation Peak dangers
items.description: A Victorian bushwalker who wanted to climb Federation Peak in Tasmania's south-west as part of his "bucket list" had turned back with his companions when he fell, a coroner says.

items.title: Men to be offered prostate screening from age 45 under new guidelines
items.description: New guidelines released today will change the way men are screened for prostate cancer and lead to less invasive testing.

items.title: AI models design viruses not found in nature for first time
items.description: Researchers from Stanford University have synthesised brand-new, self-replicating viruses using genomes designed by artificial intelligence for the first time, raising the possibility of significant medical advancements but also prompting concerns the technology could be misused.

items.title: What to know about air fryers if you’re conscious of PFAS and microplastics
items.description: Here's what three experts have to say about choosing and using an air fryer.

items.title: Do dolphins grieve the way humans do?
items.description: A dolphin mother has carried its calf's remains for 11 days in what researchers believe could potentially reveal something new about dolphin mourning.

items.title: Nicole Kidman delivers message to former school on 150th anniversary
items.description: Lane Cove Public School students put out an appeal inviting Nicole Kidman to their 150th birthday celebrations. The famous actress couldn't make it in the flesh, but she did send a message from Greece.

items.title: New jumper revealed as NRL grants Perth Bears salary concessions
items.description: The NRL says the Perth Bears can leave some player wages outside its salary cap as it pursues a marquee signing.

items.title: Artwork riffing on Renaissance painting and George Orwell wins $100k
items.description: Ryan Presley has won the top prize at the National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Art Awards for an oil painting riffing on Renaissance art.

items.title: Man says he was 'very scared' during alleged Alan Jones bedroom assault
items.description: A man accusing Alan Jones of historical indecent assault has told a court he followed the broadcaster's alleged direction to have a shower and come out in a robe because he did not want to disappoint Mr Jones.

items.title: NRL and AFL 'saturated' with gambling and alcohol sponsors, report finds
items.description: Every NRL and AFL club has an alcohol sponsor this season while every NRL and five AFL clubs are sponsored by gambling companies, a new report has found.

items.title: Men's behaviour change groups could soon face new rules
items.description: Programs range from one day sessions in schools educating boys on respectful relationships to months-long programs working with men who have abused their partners and children.

items.title: Even with new tech, experts say US is 'poorly prepared' to de-mine strait
items.description: Even with a range of high-tech equipment such as underwater drones and helicopter-mounted lasers, clearing the Strait of Hormuz of Iranian sea mine threats will be a painstaking and challenging process.

items.title: Pharmacist denies conflict of interest with man behind Essendon doping scandal
items.description: A Darwin pharmacist is facing a tribunal over allegations he inappropriately dispensed performance-enhancing drugs and did so on the basis of a conflict of interest with the man at the centre of the Essendon football club doping scandal.

items.title: 'No money left': Man stole $220k in three months to fund online bets
items.description: The Supreme Court in Hobart has heard online gambling has been "the primary cause of problems" in the man's life. He'll spend six months in prison after pleading guilty to 20 charges relating to the theft from Salmon Tasmania.
